# Antonis Nikolitsopoulos

> Personal site of Antonis Nikolitsopoulos, Thessaloniki, Greece: independent sports analytics projects (football, basketball, volleyball, handball and two PAOK statistics hubs), notes on books, a collection of quotes, and a Greek wine and food pairing finder. The forecasting projects are in their 2026-27 test season; their live records are early results.

## Sports projects
- [Greek Super League](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/superleague/): projections for every game, stat by stat, against the market's lines
- [Explainer: how dominant the Big 4 are in the Greek Super League](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/superleague/research/big-four/): against Olympiakos, PAOK, AEK and Panathinaikos the other clubs scored 23% fewer goals than their form predicted, in every season since 2019-20 (1,718 matches)
- [Greek Cup](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/football/greek-cup/): results and match stats for every game
- [Basketball, Greece and Cyprus](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/basketball/): team strength, game projections and handicap margins
- [Basketball totals](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/basketball/overs/): a totals model for 45 domestic leagues in Europe and Latin America
- [Women's basketball totals](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/basketball/women/): a totals model for 20 European leagues
- [Volleyball](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/volleyball/): sets and total points projections
- [Handball](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/handball/): total goals projections, live tests and backtests
- [Research note: close volleyball matches and the total](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/volleyball/research/close-matches/): in the closest fifth of 36,033 matches the under won 53.1% against 50.0% implied by closing prices; not bettable on its own
- [Explainer: why a volleyball total is really about sets](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/volleyball/research/how-totals-work/): totals form three humps by match length (3 sets average 131 points, 4 sets 181, 5 sets 210, across 64,184 matches); the over/under is mostly a question of how many sets
- [Track record](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/track-record/): every live test in one table, with won-lost, ROI and closing-line value, refreshed every two hours
- [PAOK Hub](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/paok-hub/) and [PAOK Basketball](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/paok-basketball/): PAOK's seasons in numbers

## Writing and collections
- [Books](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/books/): key ideas from 109 books on sports analytics, betting markets, decision-making and personal development
- [Thought Bank](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/thought-bank/): quotes and ideas, in seven folders
- [Wine](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/wine/): Greek wine and food pairing finder, 950+ wines from 110+ estates
- [What Algo Missed](https://whatalgomissed.com/): a personal map of world cinema

## About
- [About](https://antonisnikolitsopoulos.com/about/): the story behind the site and its projects
